title: US Midterms Explained: What Changes With or Without a Majority
short_title: Why 51 votes isn't enough in the US Senate 🗳️ #shorts
description:
Every two years, Americans elect a new Congress in the midterm elections, while the president is not on the ballot. How do the House and the Senate work? Why do 218 and 51 matter, and why do most laws need 60 votes in the Senate? We follow an imaginary bill through four scenarios: unified government, a House that changes hands, a Senate that changes hands, and both chambers for the other party. Neutral, educational explainer: Party A and Party B are fictional, and so is the bill.
